Twins of rowan are among the most powerful elementals on the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25), specially crafted to patrol a wide range of wilderness and maintain the plane's carefully constructed order. Despite having two heads and torsos, each twins of rowan is a singular creature; like all wood elementals, their true consciousness is not in their heads but in the roots, and their true body is the trunk of the tree, not the extended limbs. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 31 **[Recall Knowledge - Plant](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 31 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 29 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 26 [Twins of Rowan](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2680) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 211 **Perception** +26; [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet **Languages** [Arboreal](/Languages.aspx?ID=26), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Muan](/Languages.aspx?ID=108) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +24, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +26, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +21 **Str** +5 **Dex** +4 **Con** +8 **Int** +2 **Wis** +3 **Cha** +4 **Shielded Eyes** A twins of rowan's protective mask
shields them from [blinding](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) and [dazzling](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) effects. --- **AC** 34 **Fort** +24 **Ref** +17 **Will** +27 **HP** 273 **Immunities** bleed, [blindness](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1), [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145) **Weaknesses** [axes](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=1) 15, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) 15 **Beacon of the Rowan Guard** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134), [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508)) 40 feet. The lantern carried by the twins of rowan contains pure elemental life energy that resonates with and empowers all wood elementals. While within the emanation, a creature with the [elemental](/Traits.aspx?ID=57) trait and either the [plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125) trait or [wood](/Traits.aspx?ID=508) trait gains [fast healing 10](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=15) and a +2 circumstance bonus to all attack and damage rolls. The aura can be [counteracted](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) with a DC 30 check to [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78); doing so deactivates the aura for 1d6 rounds. --- **Speed** 35 feet, climb 25 feet **Melee** rapier +26 ([deadly d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Disarm](/Traits.aspx?ID=175), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 4d8+5 piercing **Melee** fist +25 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d10+5 bludgeoning **Ranged** stump +26 ([Brutal](/Traits.aspx?ID=249), [range increment 120 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 2d10+15 bludgeoning **Follow-Up Combo** The twins of rowan makes a rapier Strike, followed by two fist Strikes, all against the same target. These attacks all count toward the twins' multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the twins make their attacks. **Lifespring Burst** ([Plant](/Traits.aspx?ID=125), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134), [Vitality](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) Once per day, the twins of rowan can strike the ground with their sword, releasing a 30-foot burst of life energy centered on the twins that deals 14d6 vitality damage (DC 30 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save); the twins of rowan is immune. The area affected by this burst then becomes [greater difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) as vibrant new plant life ruptures through it. **Throw Stump** As [Throw Rock](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=38) but can also be used to throw stumps and logs.
Scions of Life Rowan trees have a long association with protection; Shumunue accordingly chose rowan as the base for the powerful guardian twins. Their weapons and protective masks are grown separately from younger saplings fed with mineral-rich magic that makes their wood as strong and sharp as steel.
